priceBook.title: Price book
priceBook.description: Your prices, price breaks and lowest acceptable price per product. The quote assistant drafts from this, and you approve every quote before it is sent.
priceBook.controlNotice: You stay in control. The assistant only drafts. Nothing reaches a buyer until you approve it, and it can never quote below your lowest price. That price is private and is never shown to buyers.
priceBook.notOn: The assistant is not switched on for your account yet, but you can prepare your price book now.
priceBook.emptyDescription: Publish a listing with a price and it appears here, ready to edit.
priceBook.seeded: Copied from your listing: review it

form.floorHint: Private. Never shown to buyers. The assistant cannot go below it.
form.termsHint: For example: Freight extra at actuals, or Free delivery above 1,000 pieces.
form.tiersHint: Higher quantities must cost less per unit, and never less than your lowest price.
form.active: Let the assistant use this entry

panel.unavailable: The quote assistant is unavailable right now. You can still send a quote yourself below.
panel.title: Quote assistant
panel.approvedNote: You approved this draft and the quote was sent.
panel.approvedNoteValid: You approved this draft and the quote was sent (valid until {date}).
panel.discardedNote: You discarded this draft. You can still send a quote yourself below.

log.empty: The assistant has not done anything for you yet.
log.label: What the assistant did

draft.guard: Drafted by the assistant. Nothing has been sent to the buyer. Check it, change anything you like, then approve.
draft.belowLimit: First price was below your limit and was replaced
draft.requestHelp: The assistant can draft a quote from the buyer's requirement and your price book. You approve it before anything is sent.

errors.tierBoth: Fill both the quantity and the price for each price break.
errors.noDraft: We could not draft a price for this requirement. Add the product to your price book, or quote manually.
